mayaCharts: Beautiful, accessible charts in five lines. Zero dependencies. The browser is the chart engine.
Uses modern platform: Custom Elements, Web Animations API, CSS Anchor Positioning + Popover, CSS custom properties.

USAGE:
HTML: <maya-chart><script type="application/json">{spec}</script></maya-chart>
JavaScript: chart.spec = {type: "bar", data, x: "month", y: "revenue"}; chart.data = newRows;
SSR: import {render, renderShell} from "mayacharts"; render(spec, {width, height});
Global: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mayacharts/dist/maya.global.js"></script>
Modules: import "mayacharts/hierarchy" (treemap, sunburst, marimekko, waffle); "mayacharts/flow" (sankey, chord); "mayacharts/radial" (radial); "mayacharts/geo" (hexmap).

SPEC FIELDS:
type: enum = required. bar line area scatter heatmap waterfall kpi dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel table treemap sunburst sankey chord marimekko waffle radial hexmap
data: Row[] = required. Row objects with field values.
y: field | field[] = required. Value field; array adds measure toggle.
x: field = "". Category field (scatter: numeric x; hexmap: state).
aggregate: sum|mean|count|min|max = sum. How rows sharing (category, series) combine.
sort: asc|desc = data order. Order categories by total across all series. bar line area heatmap.
limit: positive integer = -. Keep top N categories; rest roll up into "Other". bar line area heatmap.
series: field = null. Split into series (heatmap: row category). bar line area scatter heatmap.
path: field[] = []. Hierarchy outer to inner. treemap sunburst sankey; bar/line/area/dumbbell with drill.
size: field = null. Bubble area (sqrt scale). scatter only.
name: field = null. Point identity and tooltip title. scatter only.
totals: string[] = []. x values drawn as running-total bars. waterfall only.
stack: boolean = false. Stack series instead of grouping. bar area only.
horizontal: boolean = false. Categories on left axis. bar dumbbell.
y2: field = null. Second value field drawn as line on right axis. bar only.
format: preset|{[field]: preset|Intl} = auto. Per field or one string for all measures.
titles: {[field]: string} = {}. Display names everywhere (axis, tooltip, legend, table).
labels: boolean = null. Formatted value on marks. heatmap: true at ≥24 px.
text: {[key]: string} = {}. Localised UI strings with {0} placeholders. Keys: noData other back reset showing drilledInto zoomedTo selected selectionCleared chartOf firstOf measures crumbs positive negative above below.
locale: BCP47 = en-US. Formatting locale.
currency: ISO4217 = USD. Currency for "currency" preset.
title: string = "". Visible heading and accessible name.
description: string = "". Accessible description; auto-generated when omitted.
yDomain: [min, max] = null. Fixed value-axis domain; [hi, lo] reverses it (ranks with 1 on top). Not with y array.
xDomain: [min, max] = null. Fixed x domain. scatter only.
tooltip: boolean = true. Hover/keyboard tooltip.
legend: boolean = true if series. Legend; clicking toggles series.
drill: boolean = false. Click/Enter zooms into branch of path; breadcrumb, Back, Escape pop. treemap sunburst sankey; bar line area dumbbell with path.
select: true|"multi" = off. Click/Enter/legend selects marks; Escape clears. Not with drill. All types but sankey.
zoom: boolean = false. Drag to zoom. line area scatter. Reset, double-click, Escape restore.
animate: boolean = true. Animate updates (element only).
colors: string[]|{[series]: color} = null. Max 8; slot assignment stable across updates.
colorBy: "sign"|{target: n}|field = null. Tone by sign or target, or ramp by numeric field. Not with series. All types but heatmap and sankey.
theme: {[token]: css} = {}. Theme token overrides (CSS values, allowlisted). Tokens: font fontSize fg fgMuted grid bg accent radius tooltipBg tooltipFg focus good bad series1..series8.
grid: boolean = true. Grid lines perpendicular to value axis.
xAxis: boolean = true. Bottom axis.
yAxis: boolean = true. Left axis.
table: boolean = true. Visually hidden data table for screen readers.
$schema: string = "". Ignored; for editors and LLMs.

EXAMPLES:
1. Currency bar: {type: "bar", x: "month", y: "revenue", format: "currency", data: [{month: "Jan", revenue: 10500}]}
2. Stacked bar: {type: "bar", x: "state", y: "units", series: "region", stack: true, data: [{state: "CA", region: "West", units: 120}]}
3. Horizontal sorted limited labelled bar: {type: "bar", horizontal: true, x: "product", y: "margin", sort: "desc", limit: 5, labels: true, data: [{product: "A", margin: 22}]}
4. Sign-coloured percent bar: {type: "bar", x: "metric", y: "variance", format: "percent", colorBy: "sign", data: [{metric: "revenue", variance: 0.15}]}
5. Multi-measure line with date format and zoom: {type: "line", x: "date", y: ["revenue", "units"], zoom: true, format: {date: "date", revenue: "currency"}, data: [{date: "2024-01-01", revenue: 10000, units: 50}]}
6. Stacked area: {type: "area", x: "month", y: "sales", series: "region", stack: true, data: [{month: "Jan", region: "North", sales: 1500}]}
7. Waterfall with totals: {type: "waterfall", x: "stage", y: "amount", totals: ["Q1", "FY"], data: [{stage: "Q1", amount: 100}]}
8. Bubble scatter with select: {type: "scatter", x: "population", y: "gdp", size: "area", name: "country", select: "multi", data: [{country: "USA", population: 331, gdp: 23, area: 9.8}]}
9. Heatmap count: {type: "heatmap", x: "hour", y: "traffic", aggregate: "count", data: [{hour: "09", traffic: "high"}]}
10. Treemap drill: {type: "treemap", path: ["region", "state", "product"], y: "revenue", drill: true, data: [{region: "West", state: "CA", product: "A", revenue: 5000}]}
11. KPI with delta and sparkline: {type: "kpi", x: "month", y: "sales", format: "currency", data: [{month: "Mar", sales: 45000}, {month: "Apr", sales: 50700}, {month: "May", sales: 54500}]}
12. Dumbbell horizontal: {type: "dumbbell", x: "region", y: "revenue", series: "year", horizontal: true, format: "currency", data: [{region: "North", year: "2024", revenue: 45000}, {region: "North", year: "2025", revenue: 52000}]}
13. Bar with dual axis: {type: "bar", x: "month", y: "revenue", y2: "customers", format: {revenue: "currency", customers: "integer"}, data: [{month: "Jan", revenue: 10500, customers: 120}, {month: "Feb", revenue: 12000, customers: 145}]}
14. Ridgeline: {type: "ridgeline", x: "year", y: "value", series: "product", data: [{year: 2020, product: "A", value: 100}, {year: 2021, product: "A", value: 120}]}
15. Beeswarm: {type: "beeswarm", y: "value", series: "category", name: "id", data: [{id: "1", category: "A", value: 15}, {id: "2", category: "A", value: 18}]}
16. Parallel coordinates: {type: "parallel", x: "item", y: ["revenue", "units", "margin"], series: "region", data: [{item: "1", region: "North", revenue: 1000, units: 50, margin: 0.25}]}
17. Table: {type: "table", x: "product", y: ["revenue", "units"], sort: "desc", format: {revenue: "currency"}, data: [{product: "A", revenue: 5000, units: 100}]}
18. Radial: {type: "radial", x: "month", y: "value", series: "product", data: [{month: "Jan", product: "A", value: 10}, {month: "Feb", product: "A", value: 15}]}
19. Chord diagram: {type: "chord", path: ["from", "to"], y: "flow", data: [{from: "A", to: "B", flow: 100}]}
20. Marimekko: {type: "marimekko", x: "category", y: "value", series: "segment", data: [{category: "A", segment: "X", value: 50}]}
21. Waffle: {type: "waffle", x: "category", y: "value", data: [{category: "A", value: 45}, {category: "B", value: 30}]}

ERROR CODES:
spec-not-object: spec must be a plain object
missing-field: type/data/x (or path)/y is required but missing
unknown-type: chart type not recognized (with module hint if needed)
data-not-array: data must be an array of row objects
row-not-object: data[i] must be a plain object
unknown-field: field-valued option names no field in data
non-numeric-y: y field value not a finite number (null allowed)
non-numeric-field: size/scatter x/colorBy field value not a finite number
non-positive-value: treemap/sunburst/sankey y value must be positive
unknown-option: top-level spec key not recognized
invalid-option: option value wrong type or invalid value
option-unsupported: option not valid for this chart type or incompatible with another option
stack-unsupported: stack: true not allowed with type "line" (use "area" instead)
invalid-domain: yDomain/xDomain not [min, max] with min < max
invalid-format: format preset unknown, bad Intl options, or unsupported locale/currency
invalid-theme: theme token not recognized
unsafe-css-value: colors/theme CSS value blocked by allowlist (no url(), other functions, ; { } < > \)
invalid-size: RenderOptions width/height not a finite number > 0
unknown-state: hexmap x value is not a US state (two-letter code or full name; 50 states, DC, PR)
too-many-marks: more than 5000 marks (suggest limit or aggregate)

EVENTS AND STATE:
Events (bubbles: true, composed: true):
  maya-select {selected: Sel[], target: (Sel & {value}) | null}
  maya-view {measure, drill, window, hidden, sortBy} (user actions only; window = zoom slice; sortBy = table header click sort)
  maya-error {code, path, message} (cancelable with preventDefault())
  maya-render {} (signals host that render is complete)
Two-way sync properties:
  el.view: {measure?, drill?, window?, hidden?, sortBy?} - getter/setter (no events on set; {} resets; sortBy = [field, "asc"|"desc"])
  el.selected: Sel[] - getter/setter (no events on set)

RULES FOR AGENTS:
1. Never put functions in spec: the spec is JSON, serializable, diffable, and hashable. No callbacks, formatters, or data transforms.
2. Unknown types need imports: if type "treemap", "sunburst", "sankey", or "hexmap" fails with unknown-type, add import "mayacharts/<module>".
3. Read errors.html when MayaSpecError thrown: every error links https://bbekshr.github.io/mayacharts/errors.html#<code> with cause and fixed example.
